name: Hospitality-VQA
description: Hospitality-VQA is a vision-language benchmark designed to evaluate visual question answering models on hospitality-related images, focusing on decision-oriented informativeness rather than just factual correctness.
reputation: A very recent niche benchmark with limited community adoption so far, but relevant for evaluating VQA models in hospitality settings.
notes: Focuses on decision-relevant information needs in hospitality domain; requires domain-specific finetuning for reliable reasoning.
